scope: Explicit native pseudo-transient globalization of the existing compatible incompressible laminar research equations. Product maturity goal remains active.

versionNotes: pre-stokes-gate-source.py is the initial driver. Its NS gates were already strict; only its five-step pseudo Stokes success is superseded.

pre-advector-source contains the first native implementation and corrected Stokes driver. It copied the global vector per cell through a C++ conditional expression. Final source passes a reference and zeros only the local Stokes advector. NS and Stokes final fields were verified byte-identical.
pre-schur-integration-source preserves the corrected pseudo path before the cloud option was added. Final-source-checks used that driver and the final pseudo binary.

provenance/final-source and cloud-merge-checks describe the delivered source. Three actual complete solves check the added cloud mode and existing viscous path; no historical run is relabeled as a final-source run.

The fields reader and old Newton reference binaries were restored from prior verified archives. They are retained with their hashes; current original-operator check is performed by the pseudo/newton transport, not the reader.

method.linearization: [J(u)+M/dtau] delta=-F(u). Absolute-state matrix receives M/dtau and RHS receives M*u_old/dtau before native internal elimination; analytic convection derivative is unchanged.
method.mass: Exact native element P1 velocity L2 mass in both components, including all 3x3 basis terms. No face-velocity or pressure mass and no artificial compressibility. The Picard velocity preconditioner contains the same pseudo mass.
method.dimensions: dtau has time units after the existing reference U=L=1 nondimensionalization. Cell mass times velocity/dtau matches the momentum weak residual. This is a steady globalization; physical time integration accuracy is not qualified.
method.globalization: A finite successfully solved linearly implicit DAE step may temporarily increase the true steady residual. SER with unit growth uses dtau_new=min(max_dtau,dtau_old*||F_old||_2/||F_new||_2); max_dtau defaults to 1e6. No coefficient sweep, pseudo retry controller or automatic method switch.
method.trueResidual: All checks and physical diagnostics dispatch to the original steady operator without mass. Linearized recovery is a candidate, not an accepted physical field.
method.completion: Original internal and free-face equation residuals and weak divergence maximum <=1e-9 AND full-state coefficient change <=1e-9 for every pseudo NS and Stokes solve; linear relative residual <=1e-13. Existing U=L=1 and p/U^2 conventions, not new product or universal physical thresholds.
method.stokesFix: The original one-shot Stokes state-change exemption is valid only without pseudo time. A residual-small five-step pseudo state with change 2.8136e-4 now remains incomplete. Seven steps satisfy both gates.
method.zeroMassLimit: Explicit inverse_dt=0 reproduces original Newton Jacobian, RHS and Picard matrix byte for byte at the saved nonzero sheared8 state.
method.default: --pseudo-step 0 keeps existing Newton backtracking. A positive value selects native-laminar-pseudo-time. Product defaults and quality gates are unchanged.

controls.pressureManufacturedSolution: u=(4y(1-y),0), p=8(1-x), nu=.1, body force=(8nu-8,0)=(-7.2,0) m/s^2. This is not an unforced physical channel benchmark.

cases.supersededReason: Exploratory driver prematurely exempted pseudo-time Stokes from the state-change gate. Same five-step state fails the corrected gate; retained as a failure regression, not a current success.

cases.failure: nonlinear iteration budget exhausted; no final acceptance
nonlinear iteration budget exhausted; no final acceptance

stalledRecovery.failureOrigin: Original dense Newton backtracking exhausted all 15 trials with nonzero true steady residual. This restored state was never a physical accepted checkpoint.

conclusions: The previously stalled sheared4 nu=.01 Newton/backtracking case now completes from zero in 11 native pseudo steps. Initial dtau=.01/.1/1 dense controls converge to the same steady field, and the exact previously stalled state recovers in 12 additional native steps.

Coarse-grid P2 velocity and pressure RMS errors remain about .0940 m/s and .0719 m^2/s^2. Successful iteration does not remove spatial error, prove branch uniqueness, or qualify a physical transient solution.

Regular, finer sheared and manufactured pressure-outlet controls preserve actual final fields. Pseudo time is not always faster: finer sheared needs 11 steps versus 9 Newton; manufactured pressure needs 7 versus 5.

Cloud Schur and pseudo time work together on a 16-cell manufactured outlet with 633 to 295 Krylov products and true P1 velocity/absolute pressure RMS differences 8.69e-14/1.78e-13. This is a small full-solve control, not a large-grid speedup claim.

Wall-clock costs include native assembly, solve, recovery, original-residual checks and record I/O, but varied startup and nonexclusive host conditions prevent universal timing ratios. Recovery full path includes the original failed 6.40s plus additional 1.24s, totaling 7.64s.
